title: Niagara Falls Night Tour with Fireworks Cruise
blurb:
Explore the enchanting beauty of Niagara Falls at night with this guided tour that combines a scenic walk and a dazzling fireworks cruise. Begin at the Friendship Arch on the Parkway before strolling through illuminated city views, visiting highlights like Table Rock Welcome Centre and Queen Victoria Park. See breathtaking views of the illuminated Horseshoe, American, and Bridal Veil Falls. Conclude your evening with a spectacular fireworks cruise, witnessing the falls come alive with color against the night sky.

- Enjoy a scenic walking tour with an expert local guide
- Experience a dazzling fireworks show on a boat cruise
- Tour duration is approximately 2.5 hours, suitable for moderate walkers
